title: Why Indonesia Isn't Actually The Volcano Capital
hook: Indonesia gets the fame. One other country actually has more volcanoes.
closing: Next time you trust your gut, check the count first. Fame and numbers rarely match.
question: Seen a volcano in person? Where?

segments.say: The US tops the world with 165 volcanoes. Indonesia, everyone's guess, is only fourth, so fame is not the same as count.
Alaska alone holds 130 of them. That's more than Indonesia's whole total, so one cold state outdoes a famous volcano nation.
Three in four of Earth's volcanoes sit on the Ring of Fire. That's why Alaska, Japan and Indonesia all rank so high.
